entries.zh: 论题；考题（考试、答辩所出的题目）；审查、考试
entries.en: examination; topic or thesis set for examination; scrutiny

entries.zh: 科目；考试科目〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: examination subject; branch of study〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: M 栏残损难辨（T99），仅据西语 examen 与汉字「科」推断为考试科目义。

entries.zh: 考；考试、考核；考问
entries.en: to examine; to test; to examine by questioning
entries.notes: M 栏含例词组（其中 jóu 一词难辨），不影响词头释义。

entries.zh: 稽；稽查、查考、考核
entries.en: to examine; to investigate; to check

entries.zh: 检；检验、检查（如检查伤口）
entries.en: to examine; to inspect (e.g. wounds); to test

entries.zh: 省悟；醒悟、领悟（推究事由而明白）
entries.en: to examine the causes and so come to realize; to awaken to understanding

entries.zh: 审；审察、审问、究问
entries.en: to examine; to inquire into; to interrogate

entries.zh: 省察；反省、检点（天主教语境常指省察良心）
entries.en: to examine oneself; examination of conscience

entries.zh: 查；查明、查证；查访（如访问证人）
entries.en: to examine and verify; to make certain of; to inquire or visit as a witness

entries.zh: 试；试验、试探（试探人心）
entries.en: to test; to try; to tempt (of testing the heart)

entries.zh: 错；差错、错失；说错（言语之误）
entries.en: to err; mistake; wrong (to misspeak)
entries.notes: 音写 châg/chôg 确证「錯」，但西语栏 examinar de palabra 与「错」义不谐（疑为 errar 之误或行位错置），故降级。

entries.zh: 验；验看、查验（验伤）
entries.en: to examine; to inspect (wounds); to verify

entries.zh: 考问；口头考问、查问考核
entries.en: to examine by questioning; to interrogate

entries.zh: 补考；补行考试、补试
entries.en: to make up an examination; supplementary examination

entries.zh: 稽考；查考核对、考核查证
entries.en: to examine and verify; to check against records

entries.zh: 稽查；稽核、查察
entries.en: to inspect; to investigate

entries.zh: 查着；查明、查得（查而得中）
entries.en: to examine thoroughly; to find upon checking

entries.zh: 考较；考校、比较考核
entries.en: to examine and compare; to test; to assess

entries.zh: 查；查察、查验（疑涉执照凭据之查验）
entries.en: to examine; to inspect (possibly of licences/documents)
entries.notes: 西语栏 comolicencias 难辨（或为 con licencias），仅据汉字「查」与音写立释义。

entries.zh: 摘头摘尾；摘取头尾、零星考问（东问西问）
entries.en: to examine piecemeal, picking out bits (head and tail); to catch at questions here and there
entries.notes: 西语栏 salreando 难辨（或为 saltear），释义以汉字「摘頭摘尾」与音写为准。
